meta.title: How Filson Made The Warmest Wool Coat Possible.
meta.description:
Buy this Filson jacket here AND help me make more videos! (at no charge to you!): https://alnk.to/gzSvYW3

The most legendary coat from one of the most legendary brands of all time. The Filson Lined Mackinaw Wool Cape Coat. 

Filson makes some WARM wool jackets. However they also make the WARMEST wool jacket (or coat). So what makes the warmest coat? Is it warmer than down? Sadly no. Down is king but still this is warm enough for most things you can throw at it. The only real question is, is this jacket warmer or better than Filson's Packer? The giant coat with a wild sheepskin collar? To be honest I have no idea! But who knows anymore! Down is up! Up is down! Goodbye see you soon!
